inpatient_hospitalization.notes: 100% hospital bill payment, including consumables and medical/surgical needs - zero out-of-pocket

domiciliary_treatment.notes: Home treatment due to medical conditions or non-availability of hospital beds

ayush_coverage.notes: Alternative treatment under Ayurveda, Yoga & Naturopathy, Unani, Siddha, Homeopathy

organ_donor_expenses.notes: All surgery and hospitalization expenses incurred by donor

ambulance_cover.notes: Multiple road ambulance trips for emergency care between home and hospital

preventive_health_checkup.limit_text: Free yearly health check-up for all insured members aged above 18

no_claim_bonus_notes: Insurance Inflation Protection: 10% Sum Insured increase every year up to 100% of Base SI, whether claim or not
room_rent_capping: No room rent limits - any hospital room, ICU no charge or day limits
icu_capping: No cap on charges or number of days

maternity_coverage.notes: Hospitalisation related to childbirth not covered; ectopic pregnancy / miscarriage due to accident covered

worldwide_emergency_cover.notes: Worldwide emergency hospitalisation explicitly excluded in this plan variant

permanent_exclusions: Cosmetic/plastic procedures (unless life-threatening or medically necessary)
notable_exclusions_summary: Plan covers vision care (incl refractive >=7.5 dioptres), accident-related dental, COVID-19. Excludes maternity (except ectopic), OPD without hospitalization, worldwide emergency, infertility, bariatric (unless life-threatening), cosmetic, external congenital.
available_riders: Vision Care Treatment (incl refractive error correction)
claim_process_summary: Cashless via 11,500+ network hospitals (TPA desk processes within 60 minutes); Reimbursement via ACKO app processed within 5 days. 96% claims settlement ratio (FY 2024-25).
